newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 4,328 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 4,328 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 4,328 contracts compared with 1,052 overnight Thursday, according to the CBOT.
There were 119 wheat, 2,572 corn, 1,370 soybean, 196 soymeal, 60 soyoil, two oat, three corn puts and six soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat 3-3/4 to 5-1/2 cents higher, corn was 2-3/4 to six cents higher and soybeans were 19 to 23-3/4 cents higher.
